title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
description:
S01 E06 — Raising the Bar
A devoted father sinks his retirement savings into a neighborhood bar that shaped his life, but his loyal customer base is literally dying off; Jen Agg and Aarón help him confront his fear of change and allow his daughter to step up to the plate.

title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
description:
S01 E02 — A Spicy Affair
An Indian restaurateur facing bankruptcy must confess to his family.

title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
description:
S01 E08 — Back to Tradition
A proud Italian immigrant must give up control of his kitchen.

title: Alex vs. America

Welcoming chefs from Arizona, New Mexico and Texas to show Alex the best of the Southwest.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E05 — Alex vs Mediterranean
Eric brings in chefs from California, Texas and New York to challenge Alex in a battle of Mediterranean dishes.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E04 — Alex vs Lobster
Three lobster specialists challenge Alex in two rounds of competition to prove their skill with the king of crustaceans.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S31 E05 — Beat the Judges: Bacon
Guy Fieri challenges three chefs to prove their pork chops by making a bacon dish, and the winner goes head-to-head with an all-star judge to see who can bring home the bacon.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S32 E07 — Wine Country Chefs
Three top chefs from Northern California's wine country compete to show off their vintage; Guy Fieri welcomes them to the market with a gift basket full of local artisanal goods that they must feature in their signature dish.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S32 E05 — All-Star Rush
Four chefs who feel the need for speed compete in Grocery Rush; in a race against the clock, they'll serve a brunch in only 20 minutes and make their favorite noodle dish using 10 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S35 E11 — 10 Pounds, Two Rounds
Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to prepare two complete meals using no more than 10 lbs. of ingredients; after the chefs use half their weighted groceries to make a hearty hot lunch, they grab two items from the clearance rack to make a dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S36 E07 — Red Light Special Extravaganza
Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S38 E10 — Three Course Couples
Three chefs join forces with their spouses in a three-course competition where Guy Fieri tests their cooking chops and communication skills; the couples have one hour to make a date-night dinner with an on-the-fly dessert.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E03 — Extreme Express Lane
In the most extreme express lane challenge ever, Guy Fieri gives three all-star chefs one hour to make an upscale appetizer, entrée, and dessert using a total of only 12 ingredients! The winner gets to shop Flavortown Market for up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S40 E08 — All-Star Pizza
Guy Fieri invites all-star chefs Maneet Chauhan, Christian Petroni, Adam Sobel and Stephanie Izard for a pizza showdown; the pie makers must serve up a pizzeria combo plate using only the grocery items they can carry on a pizza paddle.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
All-Star Grocery Rush-a-Thon

title: BBQ Brawl
description:
S06 E08 — Flay V. Chauhan V. Lofaso: Into the Fire!
In the advantage challenge, team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Antonia Lofaso go primal, cooking dishes straight in the coals; the Brawlers craft massive, meaty rib feasts on Argentinian asado iron crosses for the team brawl.

title: BBQ Brawl
description:
S06 E09 — Flay V. Chauhan V. Lofaso: BBQ Duels
Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Antonia Lofaso cheer on the final five Brawlers as they compete head-to-head in two knockout duels; three competitors make it through, but waiting at the finish line is a game-changing surprise that no one sees coming.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E12 — Heart and Sole
The competitors create appetizers that include a central Asian bread and a sweet and sour treat, make a packaged product sing with sole in the entrée round and take on a dessert round featuring an Indian snack and a plethora of pastries.

title: Chopped
description:
S63 E01 — Hot and Hangry
The Chopped kitchen is buzzing as four social media influencers take to the stoves; a change of plans in the appetizer round forces some chefs to redirect, and a sea bass fiasco in the entrée round threatens to derail one competitor's dish.

title: Chopped
description:
S61 E13 — Emu Emergency
In round one, the chefs figure out if anyone has a clue what to do with emu. The competitors find a savory cake in the entrée basket. A really weird soda and an ice cream machine battle make for an enthralling dessert round.

title: Chopped
description:
S63 E08 — Hawaiian Paradise
America's 50th state knows how to cook up a good time and the fryer is a hot commodity in the appetizer round, creating dilemmas for the chefs who didn't get there first; fish and seaweed in the entrée basket keep the island vibes going strong.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E08 — Titans vs Angelo Sosa
A virtuoso of eclectic global flavors, Chef Angelo Sosa, is bringing his worldly knowledge to take on Bobby Flay's Titans in the Triple Threat kitchen. Michelin-starred chef Michael White judges.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E04 — Titans vs Danny Garcia
Brooklyn hotshot and Top Chef winner Danny Garcia keeps Bobby Flay's Titans on their toes with his elevated Dominican and Puerto Rican flavors; chef of the first Michelin-starred Mexican restaurant in New York City, Cosme Aguilar, judges the battle.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E05 — Titans vs. Kenny Gilbert
Titan Michael Voltaggio's former mentor Kenny Gilbert is here to claim a spot on the Titans' couch. His Southern-inspired global dishes do impress James Beard Award-winning chef Nina Compton, but are they enough to secure the win?

title: Bobby Flay's the Line
description:
S01 E06 — Leia Gaccione: The Saint Clair
Bobby Flay's protégée Leia Gaccione surprises her former boss in an epic brunch battle.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S28 E14 — It's All Greek to Me
It's all Greek to Bobby Flay as chefs George Kantaris and Angelo Vangelopoulos take center stage for a shot at the crown; chef Michael Symon and actress Carly Hughes cheer them on as they find out if it will be a comedy or a tragedy.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S29 E11 — Fowl Shot
Bobby Flay tries not to get dunked on by basketball legend Amar'e Stoudemire and Katie Lee Biegel; chefs Michael O'Halloran and Alex Stickland go for the upset win.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S29 E16 — Breakfast With Boswell
Stephanie Boswell and Sunny Anderson bring brunch vibes into the kitchen with chefs Gabriella Baldwin and Jenifer Minelli, who are ready for a win against Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S32 E02 — Don't Be Sour!
Chopped host Ted Allen and The View's Sara Haines sour Bobby Flay's night while chefs Grace Goudie and Andy Xu try to make lemonade out of their star ingredient.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S32 E10 — Bouillabaisse-ic Instinct
Chefs Dan Jackson and Camila Rinaldi are aided and abetted by Sunny Anderson and Jet Tila as they try to slay Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Country music superstar Martina McBride and chef Alex Guarnaschelli jam with chefs Drew Erickson and Aristide Williams to tune Bobby Flay up.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chef Antonia Lofaso partners with comedian Leslie Jones to bring the nuttiness, as chefs Josh Elliot and Vicky Colas attempt to get the last laugh over Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S35 E07 — Raise the Steaks
Michael Symon and comedian Chris Redd leave Bobby Flay in tears while chefs Adam Pawlak and Page Pressley impress with their takes on a classic.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S04 E04 — Midwest Oktoberfest
Molly hosts Oktoberfest in the Midwest and makes her favorite German-inspired dishes, starting with salty pretzels with beer cheese and sweet pretzels with cinnamon sugar; crispy chicken schnitzel; German potato salad loaded with bacon.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
Addicted to Chocolate
Molly Yeh shares her favorite choco-licious recipes to curb the cravings; she makes s'mores pie, chocolate sea salt rugelach and mini marzipan treats; rich and gooey Turkish coffee brownies will be enough to satisfy any chocolate appetite.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
Must eat Sugar, Molly's Fave Desserts
Molly is sharing some of her all-time best dessert recipes, from cookies to squares and definitely donuts in between.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S10 E07 — Molly's Sprinkle!
Molly Yeh throws a baby shower on the farm; she makes savory lentil soup in bread bowls and crave-worthy chicken Caesar salad wraps with crispy cheese; for dessert, there are glossy pink glazed yeasted donuts.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S18 E01 — How The Cookie Crumbles
Chocolate mint iced cookies decorated with swirls of snow-white royal icing; browned butter sugar cookies that become the base for cookie jam pies; next-level chocolate chip cookies with bacon and caramel corn; no bake cookies.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S23 E14 — The Pie's the Limit
Ree Drummond is in a pie state of mind, so she starts by making an incredibly decadent and party-worthy Double chocolate pie with a torched meringue topping; a fantastic waffle cone ice cream pie with shortcuts.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E08 — Housewarming Treats
Ree Drummond prepares fall sweets for visitors at her and her sister's remodeled home, by starting the housewarming with her classic s'mores cookies, shortcut cherry cheesecake brownie cups, easy apple fritters, and pumpkin pie snacking granola.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S35 E12 — Treats for Todd
Ree Drummond has a care package for her youngest college kid, Todd; she's sending him mini strawberry tarts and chocolate hazelnut oatmeal bars to share with his roommates, cheesy chipotle cheddar snack mix and spirit pretzels in his team colors.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S27 E07 — Sweet Ways to Celebrate
Sweet ways to celebrate Valentine's Day; sake and miso-marinated salmon with coconut rice and broccolini; a brownie tart; mint chocolate bonbons.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S30 E02 — The Sweetest Pairings
The Kitchen has sweet and exciting flavor pairings, like pomegranate glazed lamb lollipops, endive salad with candied nuts and agrodolce salmon; plus special guest Anne Burrell.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E03 — Yotam Ottolenghi
Chef and restaurateur Yotam Ottolenghi joins Ina Garten to talk about his deli success and the secrets to his groundbreaking recipes. Ina welcomes him with Coconut Cupcakes, and Yotam takes over the kitchen to make his Traybake Chicken.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E02 — Jeffrey Garten
Jeffrey Garten joins Ina Garten to share highlights from their 60 years together, from love-at-first-sight encounters to their long-distance challenges. Ina makes Easy Butternut Squash and Apple Soup, and Jeffrey learns to make Challah French Toast.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S30 E04 — Eating Up New Orleans
Guy Fieri takes a tasty tour of New Orleans; he goes to a butcher shop with a funky take on the Big Easy's comfort food flavors, checks out a seafood spot getting creative with their dishes and digs at a real-deal po' boy joint.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E02 — Sausage, Shawarma and Scaloppini
A funky Italian joint in Wilmington, Del., serves arancini and veal scaloppini; a Middle Eastern street food spot in San Diego serves shawarma and falafel; a not-your-typical pizza place in Vancouver tops things off with lamb sausage and pig cheeks.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S36 E03 — Sicilian and Seafood
Guy goes from incredible Italian to sensational seafood; wood-fired pizza; crab cake cioppino and crab-spinach risotto; Vanilla Ice at a pirate-inspired joint serving up Brazilian and Caribbean seafood specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S40 E03 — Pig's Feet, Mojo and Chow-Chow
Guy Fieri dives into unordinary recipes, starting in Palm Beach, Fla., where a hidden restaurant serves up seafood and chow-chow; a funky Filipino joint in Hawaii fires up its spin on pigs' feet.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S42 E04 — Meaty, Cheesy and Sweet
Waffles in Anchorage, Alaska, and steak tacos in Aspen, Colo.; in Albuquerque, N.M., a Latin place makes arepas and pork paninis.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S46 E12 — Dumpling-icious
Guy Fieri's diving into dumplings from around the world; a Japanese joint in Cincinnati fires up meaty gyozas; a Nepalese spot in Oregon showcases its traditional fare; in Los Angeles, a Lebanese-Armenian oasis puts out a dumpling dish.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S51 E02 — Sandwich Smorgasbord
Guy Fieri's having a sandwich extravaganza at a lunch spot in Indianapolis that is serving up serious flavors with the-bomb brisket au jus and rockin' roast pork.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S50 E09 — Dough-lightful Dishes
Guy Fieri's digging into dishes that begin with great dough; starting with savory venison sopes in Minneapolis; in Missoula, MT, a pizza spot is slinging artisan pies like meatball verde; a funky joint is serving up vegan doughnuts.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S53 E01 — Trinidad, Thailand and Italy
Guy Fieri checks out a Trinidadian shop in Marietta, Ga., that's plating lights-out oxtail; a Los Angeles Thai spot serves beefed-up boat noodles; an Italian joint near Cincinnati fires up primo pancetta bucatini.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S54 E03 — Pizza, Pastrami and Potato Skins
Guy Fieri explores comfort food at an Austin deli serving pastrami and a Calgary restaurant offering brisket and ribs.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S09 E04 — Fire-Breathing Pavlovas and Alien Oddities
John Henson tells an Australian fire-eater's tale before asking the bakers to create flambéed pavlovas; extraterrestrial oddities inspire alien head cakes with enough ooze to gross out Carla Hall, Stephanie Boswell and Zac Young.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S09 E05 — The Fantastic Fondante and Funhouse Hall of Mirrors
John Henson tells the story of the hall of mirrors ghost as inspiration for the bakers' Bloody Mary bar desserts; the bakers work in teams to fuse two body parts together.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S09 E06 — Heads Will Roll
The bakers dig deep with buried alive trifles honoring the carnival's failed escape artist; John Henson shares the carnival's shrunken head wind chimes to encourage the bakers to think big.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S09 E07 — Sword Swallow Your Pride
The bakers make desserts designed to melt after hearing John Henson's torrid tale of the Human Ice Pop; the bakers honor the sword swallower with a dessert that swallowed another dessert to impress judges Carla Hall, Stephanie Boswell and Zac Young.
